styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Altstadt lanes, the Rhine promenade and the big museums.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Altbier, Rheinish comfort food and the markets.

styles.label: Art
styles.blurb: K20, K21 and the NRW art scene.

stays.why: Sleep among the old-town bars and the Rhine promenade. Walk to most sights. Can be noisy at night.
Modern architecture and riverside walks. Quiet at night, a short tram or walk to the centre.
Central and well connected. Best for shopping on Königsallee and easy transit links.
Leafy left-bank neighbourhood with cafés and a Rhine view. Cross the bridge for the Altstadt.

food: Try Rheinish dishes: Himmel und Erde (black pudding with apple and potato), Sauerbraten and Reibekuchen (potato fritters).
Drink Altbier in the Altstadt brewpubs. It comes in small glasses and is refilled without asking; say when to stop.
Go to the Carlsplatz market for snacks, cheese and coffee. Check opening hours on the day.
Rheinish mustard and Printen gingerbread make easy gifts. Look in the Altstadt shops.
Book dinner ahead on weekends. Many kitchens close earlier on Sundays; check on the day.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for Schloss Benrath: a palace and gardens south of town, reachable by tram or S-Bahn. Check opening days.
Take the train to Cologne for the cathedral and old town, roughly 25–35 minutes each way. Check times and fares on the day.
On a rainy day, swap a walk for the Kunstpalast or the Film Museum. Check current exhibitions and prices.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Altstadt, the Rhine promenade and the main art museums, with time for Altbier and a market lunch.

month_notes: Cold and often wet: highs near 6°C, lows near 1°C, about 17 rain days. Pack a warm coat and an umbrella.
Still chilly: highs near 8°C, lows near 2°C, about 14 rain days. Indoor sights are a good bet.
Milder: highs near 11°C, lows near 3°C, about 14 rain days. Layers help.
Spring arrives: highs near 15°C, lows near 5°C, about 11 rain days. Good for walking the Rhine.
Pleasant: highs near 19°C, lows near 9°C, about 12 rain days. Outdoor cafés open up.
Warm: highs near 23°C, lows near 14°C, about 11 rain days. Long evenings in the Altstadt.
Warmest month: highs near 24°C, lows near 15°C, about 13 rain days. Book hotels early.
Similar to July: highs near 24°C, lows near 15°C, about 13 rain days. Busy and lively.
Still mild: highs near 21°C, lows near 12°C, about 11 rain days. A good shoulder month.
Cooler: highs near 16°C, lows near 9°C, about 14 rain days. Bring a jacket.
Cold and grey: highs near 10°C, lows near 5°C, about 15 rain days. Christmas markets may be on; check dates.
Coldest and wettest: highs near 8°C, lows near 3°C, about 17 rain days. Warm layers and waterproof shoes.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate and changeable: mild summers, cool winters, and rain in every month. Pack layers and an umbrella year-round.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect 11–17 rain days every month. Showers pass quickly; a small umbrella and a waterproof jacket help.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs around 19–24°C and long evenings. Ideal for the Rhine promenade, Altstadt terraces and parks.

items.title: Cool winters
items.text: December to February highs are 6–8°C with lows near 1–3°C. A warm coat, scarf and gloves are worth packing.

items.title: Rarely very hot
items.text: Summer highs top out near 24°C. Heatwaves are short; most days are comfortable for walking.

items.title: Good shoulder months
items.text: April, May, September and October are mild and less crowded. Rain is still likely, so keep plans flexible.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket, an umbrella and comfortable walking shoes. Add a warm coat and gloves for November to March.

transit.best: Walk in the centre; use U-Bahn and trams for longer hops and always validate your ticket.

modes.text: Rheinbahn runs U-Bahn, trams and buses. Single ticket €3.80, 24-hour pass €7.60 (2026). Validate before boarding; fines €60 for unstamped tickets.
Rheinbahn buses fill the gaps where trams don't run. Same tickets as U-Bahn and trams; validate before boarding.
Uber, Bolt and Free Now work in Düsseldorf. Handy for late nights and airport runs.
The city centre is an environmental zone; cars need a pollution sticker. Parking is limited, so a car is best for day trips out of town.
Walking is easy in the compact centre. Bike hire from about €9 a day is a good alternative.
No ferry across the Rhine. Use the bridges to cross between the centre and Oberkassel.
